title: nephelium ramboutan-ake
intro: Nephelium ramboutan-ake, commonly known as the Rambutan, is a tropical fruit-bearing tree native to Southeast Asia. The Rambutan tree has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and aiding in the management of diabetes due to its antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Nephelium ramboutan-ake include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and ascorbic acid, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. Additionally, the Rambutan tree has been used to treat various ailments, including fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems, due to its antipyretic, carminative, and expectorant properties.
